records.note: The atlas already holds a 1 July 1968 'legal_establishment' event from the Commission's 2002 financial statements (note 1); the 2004 statements (R4B-076, p. 6, note 1) say the same, 'established July 1, 1968 ... under the Medical Service Act'. That later wording is the Medical Services Plan's operating start and conflicts with the 1967 orders if read as the Commission's constitution; whether a 1968 statute re-constituted the Commission was not checked. Members are appointed by the Lieutenant Governor in Council (s. 3); the Act makes the Commission a Crown agent, gives Finance inspection, requires a Comptroller-General audit and routes its annual report through the designated Minister (ss. 6-8). The Minister first designated under the Act was not found, so no 1967 parent is recorded. The Financial Administration Act applies to the Commission 'as though it were a division' of the health ministry (2003/04) for that Act only; it is not an ordinary parent.
